Commentary.Commentary: That’s it from this game then! The hosts take a 1-0 lead in the series. Two more games to go. The second one will be played on the 9th of this month again at Sharjah. That game will begin at 10 am GMT but you can join us an hour in advance for the build up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan says that he is quite happy about the performance and is looking forward to the next game. Adds that they did believe they could defend 235 runs and given how Nabi played, they looked to get around 220 runs and then the bowlers did an amazing job. On AM Ghazanfar, he says that he is a special talent and a good kid and in the second spell, he was just on the money. On Gurbaz's injury, he mentions that thankfully they have backups and good young cricketers and it is unfortunate that Ibrahim and Mujeeb aren't there but hopefully, Gurbaz recovers for the next game.

Najmul Hossain Shanto, Bangladesh's captain, says his team started well in the first innings in the first couple of overs but when Nabi came, his team got rattled out a little bit. Batting was the primary reason for this loss. His wicket was the main difference in this match because at least one batsman has to out bat out throughout the innings and there is none from him who could have done. He praises Nabi and Rashid Khan where they bowled beautifully and Afghanistan kept really tight from the start. He congratulates Afghanistan for winning this match and he will come back stronger in the next match.
AM Ghazanfar has been adjudged the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant six-wicket haul.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the day, after being asked to field first, Bangladesh’s pacers ran through the top order of Afghanistan but Hashmatullah Shahidi, Mohammad Nabi and the lower order did very well to get them to a competitive score which in the end proved to be enough by a big margin.

For the hosts, it was the spinners who did the trick. AM Ghazanfar continued a fine start to his career with a six-fer. He was well supported by Rashid Khan and also Mohammad Nabi who got the main wicket of Najmul Hossain Shanto. Let me remind you, Afghanistan were guilty of dropping quite a few chances but still came out on top easily.

That was a collapse of gigantic proportions! At one stage, Bangladesh were cruising. They lost a wicket early but then it was Soumya Sarkar and  Najmul Hossain Shanto who steadied things. Shanto then continued the good work with Mehidy Hasan but once he fell, it was a procession. The lower order surrendered and it ended up being a big defeat for the visitors and their wait for a first ODI win in Sharjah continues, 29 years and counting.

OUT! LBW! Nicely bowled and the appeal has been listened to as the umpire raises his finger. Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A lovely shot to get off the mark from Soumya Sarkar! Overpitched and outside off, Sarkar gets on the front foot and punches it firmly through covers for the first boundary of the chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Soumya Sarkar, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: TWO WIDES! Fazalhaq Farooqi starts off with a loosener here. Comes from over the stumps and angles it full and down leg, swinging as well, Tanzid Hasan misses the flick and the ball goes past the keeper. A single taken as well.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Tanzid Hasan, 2 Wides!
